rail_tolerance.basis: TPS552882 VREF 1.188-1.212 V (DATASHEET) x divider incl. 0.1 % resistors (pintle_rail_v2); DC value - the jam is a static load

needle_load_25bar_equiv_N.basis: MECH force model: upstream 25 bar, chamber ambient; lifted = P x A_stem (opening), seated = P x (A_seat - A_stem) (closing)

backdrive.tag: LEAD 2026-10-12 performance target; B-PNT-1 measures it (unpowered servo, torque to turn the output shaft slowly in the closing direction, and at ~2 rad/s); safety shutoff = NC isolation valve

stall_monitor_clearance.note: normal-operation maximum of the interval without a 20 um progress mark while |cmd - lift| > 0.15 mm; firmware time path kPintleStallTime_s must exceed it with margin
